benefits_health_001.evidence: All teachers under written contract shall be eligible for the group insurance programs provided by the board.

benefits_health_contribution_002.answer: For teachers working less than full-time, the Board pays a percentage of premiums equal to the teacher's FTE. Full-time contribution is not specified.
benefits_health_contribution_002.evidence: The Board will pay the percentage of premiums equal to the teacher’s FTE.
benefits_health_contribution_002.coder_notes: Updated page number from 40 to 39, as the provision is located in Article 20.3 on page 39.

benefits_health_employee_premium_003.answer: For teachers working less than full-time, the employee pays a proportional share equal to 1.0 minus the teacher's FTE. Full-time premium is not specified.
benefits_health_employee_premium_003.evidence: The teacher’s proportional share equals 1.0 minus the teacher’s FTE.
benefits_health_employee_premium_003.coder_notes: Updated page number from 40 to 39, as the provision is located in Article 20.3 on page 39.

benefits_dependent_health_004.evidence: one employee pays the employee or employee plus dependent(s) amount (e.g. two employees only, one pays employee plus spouse and the other pays employee only contribution; or two employees and family, one employee pays employee plus spouse and family and the other pays employee plus family).
